title: Canvas interaction performance and larger mesh support
summary: Improved interconnect-canvas rendering and event handling through concrete frontend optimizations.

dates.note: First inspected milestone: 2024-08-28. See facts for earlier/later feature stages; this is neither proof of first-ever work nor a formal role/leadership start or shipped release date.

facts.text: Introduced Pixi.js to improve newer NoC canvas performance.
Optimized canvas interactions through cached DOM geometry, frame-batched pointer/pan updates, processing outside Angular change detection and shared zoom/pan behavior.
Improved event/subscription cleanup and resolved ResizeObserver-related memory leaks.
Extended GUI coordinate and identifier handling to support 64×64 coherent meshes.
Reduced repeated canvas event-path work through cached geometry, animation-frame batching and processing outside Angular change detection; repaired retained observer/subscription lifecycles.
The 64×64 change establishes coordinate and identifier support, not a measured full-scale rendering benchmark or a claim of 4,096 independently tested nodes.
Improved desktop rendering compatibility for CPU/headless environments and configurations without an available GPU.

notes: No defensible measured speedup, memory-reduction percentage, or before/after timing is supplied.

2026-10-27 local Git/source research supplements prior evidence. Authorship supports attributable implementation; shared components and later colleague changes retain separate ownership. No employer tests were rerun.
